purpose: Determine whether the target-free galaxy-kinematic observables and frozen backbone contain transferable information about rare present-day density amplitudes and connected high-density structure locations before attempting any further residual generator.

inherited_inputs.development_domains: reuse and reverify every TNG100, SIMBA, and Swift train/validation data and V21 frozen backbone cache path, hash, schema, and object count from V35

physical_targets.object_amplitude: log10 of the cube mean of delta squared

native_structure_thresholds.fit: one exact native-voxel truth quantile per source using train targets only; apply unchanged to that source validation

physical_targets.coarse_grid: factor-4 nonoverlapping blocks: 16^3 cells at 1.25 Mpc/h
physical_targets.coarse_positive_label: a block is positive when it contains at least one native voxel above the applicable train-only source threshold
physical_targets.connected_structure: 26-connected native validation voxels above the applicable threshold with no artificial wrap across cutout faces
physical_targets.validation_target_role: metrics only after every feature, learner, seed, threshold rule, and decision boundary is committed

target_free_features.full_block_model: the exact V34 factor-4 222-component scalar plus oriented current-scale and parent-scale observable/backbone descriptor
backbone_only_block_model: central backbone mean and standard deviation
target_free_features.object_model: for each of log1p block count, block mean radial velocity, exact population velocity dispersion, and backbone mean: mean, standard deviation, q10, q50, q90, q99, and maximum over the factor-4 grid
target_free_features.object_backbone_only_model: the same seven summaries of backbone mean only
forbidden: validation density in any feature or fitted threshold
validation-derived feature selection or hyperparameter tuning

fixed_training.source_balance: each fitted model gives equal total sample weight to every included source
fixed_training.block_rows: for each threshold and source, retain all positive train blocks up to 65536 by a frozen PCG64 permutation and the same number of negative blocks; the common minimum retained positive count across included sources sets the per-source count
model_families: pooled fit on all three train sources and evaluated separately on all validation sources
three leave-one-source-out fits, each trained on the other two sources and evaluated only on the omitted source validation
fixed_training.spatial_control: periodically roll each validation score grid by the fixed block offset (3,5,7), preserving its marginal score distribution
fixed_training.object_control: fit the same full regressor after independently applying a fixed PCG64 permutation with seed 40071 to the targets within each included train source

block_location: average precision divided by validation positive prevalence
precision and recall after selecting exactly the truth-positive block count within each validation cube
full-model average precision divided by backbone-only average precision
full-model average precision divided by fixed spatial-control average precision
connected_structure: number-weighted component recall when any selected factor-4 block intersects the component
delta-squared-mass-weighted component recall under the same hit rule
object_amplitude: RMSE divided by the equal-source train-constant RMSE
RMSE divided by the permuted-target control RMSE
fixed_metrics.object_extreme: reported diagnostically with the same metrics but not used to choose a generator branch

predeclared_support.structure_location_supported: for either threshold, pooled full-model AP/prevalence >=2.0, top-count recall >=0.20, and mass-weighted component recall >=0.50 in every domain; the corresponding leave-one-source-out values must be >=1.5, >=0.15, and >=0.35; pooled and leave-one-out full/spatial-control AP ratios must both be >=1.25 in every domain
predeclared_support.object_amplitude_supported: for both pooled and leave-one-source-out fits in every domain, full-model RMSE/constant <=0.90, Spearman >=0.30, and full/permuted-control RMSE <=0.90
predeclared_support.observable_increment_supported: diagnostic only: full/backbone average precision >=1.10 in every domain at either threshold for both pooled and leave-one-source-out fits

hard_preflight: full pytest and clean committed worktree
exact parent and V35 input/cache hashes
train-only density threshold fitting and source-balanced model fitting
no validation rows enter any fit, threshold, feature selection, or stopping rule
synthetic component matching, top-count selection, and spatial-control tests pass
Astrid and historical EAGLE remain unopened
